不要怕他们；惟有能把身体和灵魂都灭在地狱里的，
正要怕他。
那殺身體不能殺靈魂的，
不要怕他們；惟有能把身體和靈魂都滅在地獄裏的，
正要怕他。
And fear not them which kill the body
but are not able to kill the soul : but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell .

but are not able to put to death the soul. But have fear of him who has power to give soul and body to destruction in hell.
